title: Shrine
wikitext:
{{About|the game mechanic|the map area|Shrine (area)}}

[[File:Shrine.jpg|thumb|A shrine]]
'''Shrines''' are special objects that apply an effect to nearby [[monster]]s or cast [[spell]]s at nearby players. Interacting them allows the player to temporarily steal their power for themselves. This mechanic is also referred to as '''Domination'''. 

Shrines are considered a form of [[Extra Content]].

==Mechanics==
Shrines can appear randomly in most areas. Shrines are often surrounded by a pack of monsters guarding it. Initially, shrines will only buff enemies and damage players. When touched, the shrine's effect is removed and given to the player for 45 seconds (20 seconds for Divine Shrines) in the form of a status effect. Shrine effects will either buff the player (but not their [[Ally|allies]]) or cast spells that damage enemies. A player can be affected by multiple different shrine effects.

Shrine effect duration and buff effect can be modified with certain items and passives.

Certain effects from shrines, namely effect that deal with on death effects, are symmetrical. For example, enemies near an Apparition Shrine have a chance to drop influenced items on death, as do monsters killed by the player while they have the Apparition Shrine buff effect on them.

There are two kinds of shrines: Buff (green border) and Spell (blue border); Buff shrines grants [[buffs]] to affected monsters, players, the player's nearby party members. Spell shrines cast [[spell]]s around themselves or affected players, but do not originate from the player and thus are unaffected by their mods. All buff shrine effects are affected by [[buff]] duration and effect modifiers.

Right-clicking on the status icon will remove the shrine effect.

'''Skeletal Shrine''': Note that the skeletons spawned by Skeletal Shrine and Greater Skeletal Shrine are not considered [[minion]]s of the entity with the shrine effect. They are considered [[allies]], however.

===Lesser shrines===
Lesser shrines do not spawn naturally and are generated by the {{sl|Create Lesser Shrine}} skill from {{il|The Gull}}. Unlike regular shrines, they have no ongoing effects before being touched and disappear after 10 seconds, which can be modified with [[duration]] modifiers. Touching a lesser shrine grants a buff to the player for 20 seconds. Lesser Shrine buffs are also affected by Shrine buff effect and duration modifiers.

===Cycling shrine buffs===
Sources of the mod {{c|mod|Gain a random shrine buff every 10 seconds}} ([[Harmony of Purpose]], [[Runesmithing]] staff enchantment) select a random shrine buff from the above list every 10 seconds. The shrine buff is removed if the source granting it is removed. The base duration of each buff is 10 seconds. Increasing the duration through applicable modifiers allows several shrine buffs acquired this way to be active simultaneously. Note that some of the shrine buffs might not apply in all areas, such as low-level campaign areas.

If this grants the effects of a Freezing, Lightning, or Skeletal Shrine, it will grant their Greater versions instead.

In maps, small-sample testing<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/1eg6pxp/comment/lfrv81j/</ref> suggests the following rough tentative distribution of weights for the different buffs:

|+ Shrine distribution
|- 
! Shrines !! Joint weight

| Divine, Gloom || 2
|- 
| Brutal, Charged, Echoing || 10 
|-

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.30.0| 
*Covetous Shrines now have a base chance to spawn.
*Gloom and Resonating Shrines now spawn more commonly.
* For the following changes where Item Quantity has been removed, Item Rarity has been increased to compensate:
** Covetous Shrines no longer grant affected Monsters increased Item Quantity.
* Blood Shrine of Crows now grants significantly higher Chaos Resistance.
* Blood Shrines can now be removed by right-clicking the Buff icon.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.28.0|
* Resonating Shrine no longer grants a bonus per power, frenzy and endurance charge, instead now granting an additional maximum power, frenzy and endurance charge. This shrine still grants random charge generation on hit and on kill.

* Lesser Replenishing Shrine Buff now grants 100% increased Mana Regeneration Rate (instead of Regenerate 3.33% of Mana per second).

* Made Shrines easier to highlight, even when surrounded by enemies
* Fixed a bug where have multiple Evolving Shrine buffs ignored the reduced chance for monsters to upgrade rarity every time a monster upgrades rarity.
